plain: Not following logically from what came before.

webster.text: Not following from the premises; without regular inference; as an inconsequent deduction or argument.

example.quote: Alas! how inconsequent we are, both in our morality and our principles!
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 4, 1787 (2d ed. 1836)
